title: selliguea brooksii
intro: Selliguea brooksii, commonly known as the Malaysian polypody, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and relieving digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea brooksii include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its wound-healing and antimicrobial effects. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been shown to have antioxidant and immunomodulatory effects.
